correctness.rationale: For k>=3 and 1<=r<=k-2 the proof establishes the valuation identity nu_2(P_{n+d}-P_n)=nu_2(d) whenever d is a positive multiple of 4. A=[[2,1],[1,0]] satisfies A^4=I+4B modulo 16 with B=[[3,3],[3,1]], B² even; lifting gives A^{2^s}=I+2^s B modulo 2^{s+2} for all s>=2. For index classes n=a+j2^{k-r}, pairwise residue differences have exactly valuation k-r+nu_2(j-j'), so the 2^r residues exhaust their shared class modulo 2^{k-r}; each top-r-bit bin receives one hit for each a. Independent iteration checked all 45 admissible (k,r) pairs k=3..11. The top-(k-1)-bit boundary k=4 is not uniform. This finite verification is not the all-k proof.
